text: Initial 1 GiB probe verified 16,777,216 rows and all projected bytes in 140.73 s; incremental RSS 126.4 MiB passed but peak growth 94.7 MiB failed the 64 MiB target. Kept failure log and per-run content/receipt reports. Repeating with a fixed, pre-touched 128 MiB heap and four active processors, and recording per-case memory even when the final gate fails. No full resource qualification claim yet.
